name: Deccan Cube Open - Sep 2017

venue.name: Rawindra Bhaarathi School
venue.address: 13, Dr A S Rao Nagar Rd, Arul Colony, Creative Nagar, Dr AS Rao Nagar, Secunderabad, Telangana 500062, India

information: Partipants needs to pre-register for the event in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 17th September 2017 to participate. Participation registration for the event closes on 15th September 2017 at 9:00pm IST. Payment also should be made before 15th September 2017 9:00pm IST. Please note once you register in WCA site for the DC open - Sep 2017, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events. For payment of fees please go to the **Registration Fee and Payment Tab** Additional information will be provided in the tabs.
